decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is promoted as a new product line on its own page, ties closely into the core dental practice software, and fits the firm's push toward digital practices.
A continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and practitioner relationships, adds customer loyalty and revenue, and costs little to keep running.
A remote screen-sharing support tool is basic infrastructure for efficient customer support across a growing installed base, so dropping it would hurt service quality.
